description: Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha - Lists for Roads and Thoroughfares for the Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically the confirmation and listing of roads and thoroughfares owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Anamaduwa local government authority. It contains detailed schedules of road properties with coordinates, lengths, and widths, making it primarily about land ownership and property registration matters that fall under the Land Gazettes classification.
